scope: Current definitions and stated elementary lemmas only; does not accept any future additions
findings: ForestAPI actualize_cover/anchored_actualize preserve the actual-edge requirement, anchor and cost; same-vertex heredity supplies the exact unrestricted CS premise.
ForestMatching leaf induction constructs matching/cover witnesses without an optimizer assumption; weak duality establishes the claimed true maximum.
Exposable is correctly existential over all true maximum matchings. Equal-cover saturation and exposable-independence are sound in any graph supplied with a matching-equal vertex cover.
No alternating-path/reach representation is introduced yet; any future representation needs a separate semantic review before use.
